name: Baked egg breakfast burritos
description: Soft egg bake rolled in a warm tortilla and topped with salsa.
steps: Whisk the eggs with the milk, chopped onion and pepper.
Pour into a small greased baking dish and bake at 350 F for 20 to 25 minutes until set.
Warm the tortillas for 20 seconds in the microwave.
Cut the egg into two pieces, roll each in a tortilla and top with salsa.

source.name: Adapted from USDA MyPlate Kitchen: Breakfast Burrito with Salsa

name: Broccoli and cottage cheese omelet
description: Veggie-packed omelet with a creamy cottage cheese filling.
steps: Chop the broccoli and pepper and saute in a little oil for 4 minutes.
Whisk the eggs with the milk and cook half at a time in a hot nonstick pan.
Spoon cottage cheese and vegetables onto half of each omelet.
Fold over, cook one more minute and serve.

source.name: Adapted from USDA MyPlate Kitchen: Broccoli Omelet

name: Overnight oats with yogurt and berries
description: No-cook oats soaked overnight in milk and Greek yogurt.
steps: Stir the milk, yogurt and honey together in a jar.
Mix in the oats.
Top with the frozen berries.
Cover and chill overnight; eat cold or warmed.

source.name: Adapted from USDA MyPlate Kitchen: Overnight Oatmeal with Berries

name: Potato and egg burritos
description: Crispy potatoes, onion and scrambled egg wrapped in a tortilla.
steps: Dice the potatoes and cook in oil with the onion, pepper and garlic for about 10 minutes until tender.
Push the potatoes aside and scramble the eggs in the gap.
Stir everything together.
Fill the tortillas and top with cheese and salsa.

source.name: Adapted from USDA MyPlate Kitchen: Breakfast Potato and Egg Burritos

name: Greek yogurt parfait with banana and berries
description: Quick high-protein parfait layered with fruit and oats.
steps: Slice the banana.
Spoon half the yogurt into each of two glasses.
Sprinkle with oats.
Top with banana and berries.

source.name: Adapted from USDA MyPlate Kitchen: Yogurt Berry Parfait

name: Baked egg and cheese with toast
description: Fluffy oven-baked eggs with melted cheese, served with toast.
steps: Heat the oil in a small baking dish in a 350 F oven.
Beat the eggs with the milk and shredded cheese.
Pour into the hot dish and bake about 20 minutes until firm.
Serve with toast.

source.name: Adapted from USDA MyPlate Kitchen: Sure to Please Baked Egg and Cheese

name: Tuna cheese quesadillas
description: Crisp tortillas filled with tuna and melted cheese.
steps: Mix the tuna with the yogurt.
Spread on half of each tortilla and top with cheese.
Fold and brown in a dry skillet 2 to 3 minutes per side.
Cut into wedges.

source.name: Adapted from USDA MyPlate Kitchen: Tuna Quesadillas

name: Black bean and cheese quesadillas
description: Cheesy quesadillas stuffed with beans and salsa.
steps: Drain the salsa and beans.
Mix the beans, salsa and cheese.
Spread over half of each tortilla and fold.
Brush the pan with oil and cook until golden and crisp, about 5 minutes, flipping once.

source.name: Adapted from USDA MyPlate Kitchen: Black Bean Quesadillas

name: Greek yogurt chicken salad sandwiches
description: Creamy chicken salad piled on whole wheat bread.
steps: Simmer the chicken in water for about 15 minutes until cooked through, then dice.
Mix with the yogurt, celery, onion and diced apple.
Chill briefly.
Spoon onto the bread to make sandwiches.

source.name: Adapted from USDA MyPlate Kitchen: Chicken Salad

name: Black bean and rice salad
description: Hearty cold rice and bean salad with a light dressing.
steps: Cook the rice, then cool it.
Mix the rice, beans, onion and pepper.
Shake the oil, garlic, salt and pepper into a dressing.
Pour over and chill, or serve right away.

source.name: Adapted from USDA MyPlate Kitchen: Black Bean and Rice Salad

name: Turkey and bean tostadas
description: Crisp tortillas topped with seasoned turkey, beans and cheese.
steps: Brown the turkey in a skillet and stir in salsa.
Bake the tortillas at 375 F for 5 minutes until crisp.
Spread with beans, turkey and cheese and bake 2 more minutes.
Top with shredded lettuce.

source.name: Adapted from USDA MyPlate Kitchen: Turkey Tostadas

name: Tuna tomato pasta
description: Quick pasta with tuna, broccoli and tomato sauce.
steps: Boil the pasta and drain.
Soften the onion and broccoli in oil.
Add the tomatoes and simmer 5 minutes.
Stir in the tuna and pasta and heat through.

source.name: Adapted from USDA MyPlate Kitchen: Tuna Pasta

name: Black bean cheese burritos
description: Mashed black bean burritos for breakfast or lunch.
steps: Mash the beans with the oil and mix in onion and tomato.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with the beans and cheese and roll up.
Microwave 15 seconds and top with salsa.

source.name: Adapted from USDA MyPlate Kitchen: Black Bean Burrito

name: Tuna salad on greens
description: Tuna salad on crisp romaine with bread on the side.
steps: Toss the romaine, grated carrot and half the onion with the oil.
Mix the tuna with the yogurt, celery and remaining onion.
Pile the tuna on the greens.
Serve with the bread.

source.name: Adapted from USDA MyPlate Kitchen: Tuna Salad on Greens

name: Chicken and vegetable rice bowl
description: Soy-honey glazed chicken and vegetables over rice.
steps: Cook the rice.
Stir soy sauce and honey with a splash of water.
Cook the chicken cubes in oil with garlic, then the vegetables one at a time.
Add the sauce, bubble until glossy and serve over rice.

source.name: Adapted from USDA MyPlate Kitchen: Brown Rice, Sizzling Chicken and Vegetables

name: Chicken stir-fry with rice
description: Fast chicken and vegetable stir-fry over white rice.
steps: Cook the rice.
Stir-fry the vegetables and garlic in oil over high heat.
Add sliced raw chicken and cook until done, about 6 minutes.
Add the soy sauce and serve over rice.

source.name: Adapted from USDA MyPlate Kitchen: Chicken Stir Fry

name: Braised chicken thighs with spinach and rice
description: Tender chicken thighs simmered with onion, garlic and spinach.
steps: Brown the thighs in a little oil and set aside.
Cook the onion and garlic until soft.
Return the chicken, add a cup of water and simmer covered for 30 minutes.
Stir in the spinach until wilted and serve over cooked rice.

source.name: Adapted from USDA MyPlate Kitchen: Braised Chicken Thighs with Spinach

name: Turkey meatloaf with sweet potatoes
description: Oat-bound turkey loaf baked with sweet potato wedges.
steps: Mix the turkey with the oats, egg, chopped vegetables and tomato.
Press into a loaf pan and bake at 350 F.
Cut the sweet potatoes into wedges and roast alongside.
Slice when the loaf reaches 165 F.

source.name: Adapted from USDA MyPlate Kitchen: Turkey Meatloaf

name: Beef, bean and macaroni skillet
description: One-pan beef, beans and macaroni in tomato sauce.
steps: Brown the beef and drain off the fat.
Cook the onion and pepper until soft.
Add the tomatoes, pasta, beans and half a cup of water.
Cover and simmer about 20 minutes until the pasta is tender.

source.name: Adapted from USDA MyPlate Kitchen: Easy Beef Supper

name: Tofu and broccoli with rice
description: Golden tofu and broccoli in a soy garlic sauce.
steps: Press the tofu dry, cut into slabs and pan-fry until golden.
Cook the garlic, then the broccoli with a splash of water until tender.
Return the tofu and add the soy sauce.
Serve with cooked rice.

source.name: Adapted from USDA MyPlate Kitchen: Tofu and Broccoli

name: Cuban black beans and rice
description: Garlicky black beans over fluffy rice.
steps: Cook the rice.
Saute the garlic, onion and pepper in oil for 3 minutes.
Add the beans with a little water and simmer 10 minutes.
Spoon over the rice.

source.name: Adapted from USDA MyPlate Kitchen: Cuban Beans and Rice

name: Macaroni and beans in tomato sauce
description: Peppery tomato bean sauce tossed with macaroni.
steps: Cook the pasta and drain.
Saute the garlic and pepper in oil for a minute.
Add the tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes.
Stir in the beans and pasta and heat through.

source.name: Adapted from USDA MyPlate Kitchen: Mac and Beans Medley

name: Turkey and vegetable stir-fry with rice
description: Ground turkey and frozen vegetables over rice in 25 minutes.
steps: Cook the rice.
Brown the turkey with the garlic in oil.
Add the frozen vegetables and cook until hot and tender.
Season with soy sauce and serve over rice.

source.name: Adapted from USDA MyPlate Kitchen: Vegetables and Turkey Stir-Fry

name: Beef and noodles skillet
description: Savory ground beef and pasta cooked in one pan.
steps: Brown the beef with the onion and drain.
Add the pasta and about 2 cups water.
Simmer covered 15 minutes, adding the frozen vegetables near the end.
Season with salt and pepper.

source.name: Adapted from USDA MyPlate Kitchen: Beef and Noodles

name: Chickpea and spinach saute with rice
description: Tomato chickpea saute with spinach over rice.
steps: Cook the rice.
Saute the onion, garlic, celery and carrot in oil until soft.
Add the tomatoes and chickpeas and simmer 5 minutes.
Fold in the spinach until wilted and serve over rice.

source.name: Adapted from USDA MyPlate Kitchen: Chickpeas and Spinach Saute

name: Huevos rancheros rice bowls
description: Fried eggs on rice and black beans with fresh salsa.
steps: Cook the rice in water until tender, about 15 minutes, and warm the beans.
Fry the eggs in the oil in a nonstick pan, 2 to 3 minutes a side.
Spoon rice and beans into four bowls, top with eggs and salsa.

source.name: adapted from MyPlate Kitchen

name: Potato and spinach frittata
description: Eggs baked with potato, spinach, onion and pepper in one skillet.
steps: Cube the potatoes, microwave or boil them until just soft, and let them cool.
Saute the onion, pepper, spinach and potato in the oil for 5 to 8 minutes.
Beat the eggs with salt and pepper, stir in the vegetables and pour into the skillet.
Cook on low heat until almost set, cover and rest 5 minutes.

source.name: adapted from MyPlate Kitchen

name: Potato and tomato skillet omelet
description: A thick potato omelet with tomato and onion, cut into wedges.
steps: Cut the potatoes into thin strips and brown them in the oil for 8 to 10 minutes.
Beat the eggs with salt, then stir in drained tomatoes and chopped onion.
Pour over the potatoes, cover and cook on medium heat about 8 minutes until firm.
Cut into four wedges.

source.name: adapted from MyPlate Kitchen

name: Bean and egg rice plates
description: Rice, mashed black beans and peas topped with egg and salsa.
steps: Cook the rice in water until tender.
Mash the beans with a fork and warm them with the vegetables.
Scramble the eggs in the oil until firm and cut into pieces.
Layer rice, beans and vegetables on plates, top with egg and salsa.

source.name: adapted from MyPlate Kitchen

name: Tofu and egg scramble
description: Crumbled tofu browned with spinach and pepper, finished with egg.
steps: Drain the tofu and crumble it with a fork.
Saute the tofu, chopped pepper and spinach in the oil until lightly browned.
Beat the eggs, stir them in and cook until firm. Season with salt and pepper.

source.name: adapted from MyPlate Kitchen

name: Sweet potato and bean hash with eggs
description: Sweet potato, pepper and black beans pan-cooked and topped with fried egg.
steps: Cube the sweet potatoes small and cook them in a covered skillet with a splash of water for about 15 minutes.
Add most of the oil, onion, pepper and garlic and cook 10 minutes until browned.
Stir in the beans to heat through.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil and top each portion.

source.name: adapted from MyPlate Kitchen

name: Apple cinnamon oatmeal
description: Rolled oats cooked with chopped apple and cinnamon.
steps: Peel, core and chop the apple.
Bring the water to a boil, stir in oats, apple and cinnamon.
Cook on low for 5 minutes, stirring often.

source.name: adapted from MyPlate Kitchen

name: Banana peanut butter oatmeal
description: Creamy oatmeal stirred with mashed banana, honey and peanut butter.
steps: Heat about 3 cups of water until steaming and stir in the oats for 1 to 2 minutes.
Off the heat, stir in mashed banana and honey.
Divide into bowls and swirl in the peanut butter.

source.name: adapted from MyPlate Kitchen

name: Lentil taco rice bowls
description: Spiced lentils and peppers in tomato, served over rice.
steps: Simmer the lentils in 3 cups of water for 10 minutes.
Add chopped pepper, garlic, tomatoes, chili powder, cumin and basil with a little water.
Simmer 30 minutes, adding water if it dries out.
Cook the rice and serve the lentils over it.

source.name: adapted from MyPlate Kitchen

name: Lentil carrot stew
description: Lentils, carrots and tomatoes simmered into a thick stew.
steps: Soften the chopped onion in the oil for 3 minutes.
Add the lentils, sliced carrots, tomatoes, 3 cups of water, garlic powder and chili powder.
Simmer uncovered about 25 minutes until the lentils are tender.

source.name: adapted from MyPlate Kitchen

name: Beef and lentil chili
description: Ground beef, lentils and tomatoes in a quick chili.
steps: Brown the beef in a large pot, breaking it up, and drain the fat.
Add chopped onion and garlic and cook until soft.
Add rinsed lentils, tomatoes, 2 cups of water, chili powder and cumin.
Simmer about 35 minutes until the lentils are tender.

source.name: adapted from MyPlate Kitchen

name: One-pan chicken, potatoes and corn
description: Browned chicken and potatoes finished with salsa and vegetables.
steps: Cube the potatoes and microwave or boil them until tender.
Cube the chicken and brown it in the oil on high heat for 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes and cook until lightly browned.
Stir in the salsa and frozen vegetables and heat through.

source.name: adapted from MyPlate Kitchen

name: One-pan turkey taco rice
description: Ground turkey, rice and tomatoes with cheese on top.
steps: Brown the turkey with the chopped onion and blot up any grease.
Add the rice, tomatoes, salsa, chili powder, cumin and 3 cups of water.
Cover and simmer about 20 minutes until the rice is tender.
Top with the cheese and cover until melted.

source.name: adapted from MyPlate Kitchen

name: Chicken jollof rice
description: Chicken thighs and rice cooked in a spiced tomato sauce.
steps: Cube the chicken and brown it in the oil.
Add chopped onion and pepper and cook until soft.
Add the tomatoes, thyme, black pepper and crushed red pepper and simmer 15 minutes.
Add the rice and 2 cups of water, cover and cook about 20 minutes until tender.

source.name: adapted from MyPlate Kitchen

name: Beef and bean taco soup
description: Ground beef, black beans, tomatoes and vegetables simmered together.
steps: Brown the beef in a pot and drain the fat.
Add the tomatoes, vegetables, beans, chili powder, cumin, garlic powder and a splash of water.
Simmer on low about 25 minutes.

source.name: adapted from MyPlate Kitchen
